title: Hold a hydroponic equipment dealer's licence
what: Carry on the business of selling prescribed hydroponic equipment by retail only while holding a dealer's licence.

sources.title: Hydroponics Industry Control Act 2009 (SA)
sources.publisher: South Australian Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.quote: A person must not— (a) carry on the business of selling prescribed equipment by retail; or (b) hold himself or herself out as carrying on such a business, unless the person holds a licence under section 11
